name: python-idempotency-keys
title: {{ title }}
blurb: Idempotency keys over SQLite: claim the key, run the effect, store the answer, and replay it byte-for-byte on retry. The demo counts effects, not answers, and shows the one window no key table can close.
default_description: An idempotency-key store and guard: one effect per key, replays on retry, a lease so a crashed worker does not wedge the key.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff
